Britain's war on trans people continues. Over the past few years, anti-trans campaigners have used the legal system to change the law to limit trans rights. Most recently, new guidance from the Equality and Human Rights Commission has set out new guidance for single-sex spaces and services. I caught up with Oscar Davies, the Non-Binary Barrister, to explain these new guidelines and how we got here.
